answer: Edges in the trust graph lose 10 percent weight every epoch they go unused. Eight independent edges at full weight are needed to grade, and a recruit's sponsor is excluded from its panel by construction. Disagreement splits the reward by the number of dissenters, so 3 dissenters cut a payout to 40 percent, a delta the farm cannot average away. A falcon-fast operation needs 800 live edges for 100 clones and cannot thread one node of the graph twice.
